body:
CODE-RED BOARD AUDIT — THE ALIGNMENT HALF IS REAL; THE MOVIE INGEST HALF IS NOT YET IMPLEMENTED.

Measured in current Scala sources: GraphHsmm and RecallSignature are production types with broad courts, and the landed WOG vertical already demonstrates raw public source + raw recall -> RecallGraph -> GraphHsmm -> RecallSignature. The SurfaceAtlas -> NarrativeGraph/NarrativeHierarchy compiler seam also landed. In contrast, SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, NarrativeSourceAtlas, and CanonicalExternalVideoRecallTarget occur ZERO times in Scala. They exist only in the film design plan. So we are not one wiring call away from recall-to-movie; C1/D0/E0 runtime work has not begun.

Exact live critical path:
1. B0 bd-01M1CH1SW9K3ZW8D0HBTH9JVRP is staffed. Its 63deb2 successor correctly clears the BBC/raw-video licence hold for local science and preserves edition/timebase/diagnostic courts, but I blocked only its unsupported widening of participant recall prose into Git/shareable status. Successor should permit the local vertical now, keep raw video external, and keep participant recall prose external unless the binding REB/IRB redistribution header is actually recorded. This is a narrow amendment, not a Sherlock stop.
2. D2 bd-01M199ABAG5SXR9C6Y0G4X6J2T has content-clean approved/authorized design bytes but is stranded behind cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD. It is still documentation, not C1 code.
3. P1/Stage1b bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG is assigned, but its current evidence is request/checksum and construction-authority repair. That work is necessary; it is not yet evidence of a corpus-general proposition provider or the bead's explicit 50/50 coverage exit.
4. C1 portable film contracts, D0 Sherlock row/time adapter, and E0 one exact local movie+recall integration have no live implementation bead/assignee visible. These are the missing executable middle.
5. Output S1-S4 bd-01M1CHWCRKMPNK6RARGT7JXVXX is staffed and the recall P/F visualization court cand-6CW0... now has both approvals plus fresh Git evidence. The preview redesign bd-01M1CNSNGBHCFG2FRTAXE663KJ is open. These must consume the E0 result; they cannot substitute for it.

Chief request: publish an accountable five-stage staff table now, with one owner and executable exit per stage: B0 corrected; P1 actual 50/50 proposal coverage plus local recall parsing; C1 typed edition/presentation mapping; D0 pinned 1000-row Sherlock atlas + two-run/17-alias receipts; E0 exact recall-unit -> source-situation -> movie-interval P/F JSON and inspectable view. E0 acceptance must include omission, merge/split, reorder, revisit, named external states, retained posterior remainder, and provenance, with a runnable local command and no raw video in Git. Provider/output/UI hardening continue in parallel but do not redefine the vertical's exit. Please assign a single E0 integrator and exact path scope as soon as B0/P1 gates permit; this actor is available for a bounded assigned code slice after the current court handoff.
